observation: d_min=0.03 — late-time production (2022-2025) is flat at 400-950 bbl/month with no decline trend. Lowering terminal decline from 0.05 to 0.03 reduced MAPE from 0.6292 to 0.4938. R2 outsample still very negative (-23.07), model still struggling with this volatile well.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 — no change in MAPE (0.4938). Optimizer converges to same fit regardless of initial qi guess. The curve fitting is robust to initial conditions for this well.

outlier_threshold=0.20 — no effect, rejection rate unchanged at 3.45%. The outlier detection may be dominated by other preprocessing steps or the window/threshold combo does not capture the operational dips differently.

smoothing_window=5 — MAPE worsened to 0.5026. Smoothing included more months (fit_months 252→300) and improved insample R2 (-0.02→0.40), but the broader smoothing over-smoothed the holdout-adjacent data, hurting out-of-sample prediction.

significance_threshold=0.35 — fit failed with Di < Dterm error. Including too much flat late-life data made the initial decline appear lower than terminal decline (d_min=0.03), causing convergence failure.
significance_threshold=0.40 — no change, fit_months still 252. Threshold reduction from 0.50 to 0.40 did not include any additional months in the fit window.
peak_merge_distance=6 — no change. fit_months still 252, preprocessing unchanged. The production segment selection is stable.

significance_threshold=0.75 — MAPE worsened to 0.4987. fit_months increased to 343 (counterintuitively more data). R2 insample improved to 0.7151 but out-of-sample worse. Threshold affects peak selection, not month filtering.

outlier_window=5 — no change in MAPE despite increased rejection (3.45%→4.6%) and fewer fit months (252→249). Outlier removal alone does not improve the fundamental mismatch between declining model and flat/rising production.
qi_multiplier_upper=3.0 — no meaningful change. R2 outsample shifted trivially (-23.0652→-23.0648). The qi constraint did not alter the fit materially; optimizer finds same local minimum.
smoothing_window=2 — no change. Most preprocessing parameters have no effect on this well at current settings. The 252-month fit window and model parameters are extremely stable.

peak_merge_distance=2 — identical result. The 252-month fit window is completely insensitive to peak_merge_distance changes (2, 3, or 6). The segment selection logic appears locked to the same production phase.
